correctness.rationale: For finite connected simple unit-edge cactus, the oriented incidence map D restricts H=sum-zero potentials isomorphically to edge-gradient space W, whose cycle-space constraints decompose orthogonally into independent bridge coordinates and edge-disjoint cycle zero-sum blocks. Uniform Lebesgue on centered Lipschitz ball maps by constant Jacobian to product of uniform [-1,1] intervals and central cube slices. Each bridge variance=1/3; permutation invariance makes r-cycle covariance a_r P_r, with a_r from conditioned uniform-sum density and a3=5/12,a4=2/5. Congruence inversion yields Cov(X)^+=D^T (3I_bridge+sum a_r^-1 P_C)D=L_w and hence labeled edge recovery by negative off-diagonals. The weighted matrix-tree theorem gives determinant 3^-b/n prod_C(a_r^(r-1)/r). Laplace expansion around sinc Fourier saddle gives a_r=1/3+1/(5r)+O(r^-2). Independent exact rational check a3=5/12 and noncactus K2,3 precision(0,2)=-3/8, including zero row sums. Inspected checker which computes covariances via leading Ehrhart coefficients for seven cacti; its finite test is supplemental, not the all-cactus argument.
